subject: TCT RQT / HANDYSIZE-SMAX / DLVY FUJAIRAH / RDLVY ECSA / LAY 20-30 MAY 2025
body:
Dear Team,

Good morning from Milan. We are working a TCT requirement for a European trading house, details below. Pls circulate within your network and revert with any suitable offerings WOG.

TYPE: Time Charter Trip (TCT)

VESSEL TYPE: Geared Handysize or Supramax
DWT: Min 25,000 mts (max abt 58,000 mts)
GEAR: Mandatory — minimum 4 x 25T cranes (no gearless considered)

REDELIVERY: ECSA range (East Coast South America, broadly Rio to Buenos Aires, exact port charterers' option)

BUNKERS ON DELIVERY/REDELIVERY: DLOSP / AFSPS, price to be agreed

- Vessel must be free of any average / LoU outstanding

- Hold condition: holds clean, cert on delivery
- COF/ISPS/MLC all valid, no Flag State deficiencies last 2 inspections
- CII rating C or above preferred

subject: RE: MV DESERT EAGLE — SUB LIFT + FIXTURE CONFIRMATION + ADDL CLAUSES
body:
Buongiorno,

Hope this finds you well. We are pleased to revert on the above and can confirm the following:

1. SUBS LIFTED — We hereby confirm lifting of all subjects on MV DESERT EAGLE. Vessel and cargo stems confirmed on our end. Please treat this email as formal sub-lift notification.

2. FIXTURE CONFIRMATION — All terms as per our recap dated 30 April 2025 are accepted and reconfirmed without amendment, save for the below two additional points which we request be incorporated into the CP prior to signing:

ADDITIONAL CLAUSE A — FUMIGATION:
"Should fumigation of cargo and/or vessel holds be required at discharge port, same to be carried out at Charterers' time and expense. Owners to provide full cooperation and access. Any delay caused by fumigation not to count as laytime or demurrage."

ADDITIONAL CLAUSE B — ETA NOTICE:
"Owners/Master to provide Charterers and Charterers' agents with minimum 3 (three) days prior notice of vessel's ETA at load port and discharge port. Failure to provide timely ETA notice may affect laytime commencement per NOR terms agreed."

We consider these standard protective clauses and do not expect any objection from Owners' side. If Owners have comments, pls revert by COB tomorrow Dubai time.

3. NOR / LAYTIME — For the avoidance of doubt, NOR terms as per recap remain WIBON WIPON. Laytime to commence 6 hours after valid NOR tendered, whether in berth or not.

Our ops team (copied) will coordinate directly with your ops desk re vessel ETA and pre-arrival documentation once owners confirm readiness.

Looking forward to a smooth operation.

Warm regards,
Khalid Al-Busaidi
Chartering & Logistics Manager

Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
